notes.title: Version 1.1.1
notes.notes:
In version 1.1.1 we've improved controller responsiveness at higher framerates.

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed input lag on higher framerates.
[*] Fixed game freezing occasionally when entering controls screen in co-op.
[*] Fixed minor visual glitch on ball trails.
[/list]
Visit the official [url=https://shattergame.com/]Shatter website[/url] and follow PikPok on [url=https://twitter.com/PikPokGames]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/pikpokgames]Facebook[/url] for the latest news and updates!

Thanks for your support!

notes.title: Version 1.1.0
notes.notes:
In version 1.1.0 we've addressed issues where the shatter ball would stutter while playing at a high refresh rate, issues where player leaderboard positions would display incorrectly, and we've made some changes to the balancing of circular levels and the Cold Shoulder boss.
 
[h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed ball stuttering issue. 
[*] Fixed Leaderboard display issues.
[*] Adjusted controller sensitivity in circular levels.
[*] Boosted the power of the “blow” mechanic during the Cold Shoulder boss encounter.
[/list]
[h2][b]Known issues: [/b][/h2]
[list]
[*] Issue where players are experiencing input lag.
[/list]
Thank you for all your feedback and support as work through these fixes!

If you're experiencing issues in Shatter Remastered Deluxe, you can reach our Customer Support team by emailing Support@PikPok.com. Please make sure to include the platform/OS you're playing on in your message.

Visit the official [url=https://shattergame.com/]Shatter website[/url] and follow PikPok on [url=https://twitter.com/PikPokGames]Twitter[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/pikpokgames]Facebook[/url] for the latest news and updates!

notes.title: Version 1.0.1 Hotfix
notes.notes:
A hotfix has been released addressing an issue pointed out by a number of players in the community. 

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where VSync wasn't initializing properly and where frame limiting was occurring when VSync was disabled
[/list]
[b]Note:[/b] We aim to address many of the issues raised by our community as soon as possible and will have hotfixes rolling out throughout the upcoming week.

Reminder: If you're experiencing issues in Shatter Remastered Deluxe, you can reach our Customer Support team at Support@PikPok.com. Please make sure to include the platform/OS you're playing on.
